blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Wednesday congratulated Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on his 25 years of continuous public service. His message came as India’s Union Cabinet passed a resolution congratulating Modi on completing 25 years of continuous leadership as head of government. “From Gujarat to leading the world’s largest democracy, Prime Minister Modi’s journey has been marked by a strong emphasis on good governance, innovation, technology, infrastructure and development, contributing to India’s transformation and its growing role on the global stage,” Marcos said in a social media post.
